viewing_check: Take a block of the end grain or a scraped corner: Huon pine has a strong sweet resinous smell, very fine even growth rings and a pale golden colour; if it is odourless and coarser it is likely celery-top, King Billy or another pine and worth under $50. Measure length, width and thickness, and check the bark-edge inclusion for rot or insect damage and the face for checks and cupping.
